name: standing-high-pulley-cable-curl.html
instructions:
1. For the standing high pulley cable curl, you'll need a cable machine with two high pulley cable attachments. Set up by attaching a single grip handle to each of the high pulley cables and selecting the weight you want to use on the stack.
2. Grip each of the cables with an underhand grip (palms facing up) and stand in the center with your arms outstretched. This is the starting position.
3. Keeping your upper arms and body fixed, curl the handles in towards your body as close as possible.
4. Pause, and then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for desired reps.
